new_all_degree_arguments: For every finite Gamma in SL2,higher derivative images in the bottom invariant algebra are exactly degree>=k;local polar slices give the full chart-intersection regularity test.
Three explicit invariants f,g,c give the full exceptional base rings by quadratic relations,algebraic independence,scalar-i parity and the already exact Molien series.
A smooth affine rank-two cover Z of a separate SL2 and a regular birational map Z->SL2/Gamma are additive torsors over the same punctured base;the latter is a homotopy equivalence.

The volume pullback is exactly target_volume/(nm). The quadratic deck involution is cohomologically identity through scalar i on the base,so anti-invariant three-forms are exact in cohomology. This proves normalized quadratic Haar trace,despite branching.
The image algebra is exactly delta^j(a) divisible by eta^j for every j;in its two coefficients this becomes K^ceil(j/2) and K^floor(j/2). Every phase and marker is constrained.
A rational slice makes the invariant volume exact on its regular locus,so no representative of the nonzero Haar top cycle can avoid its poles.
Exact Laurent endpoint divisibility and a beta constant-term formula compute all regular Haar moments as torsor transgression residues.
The natural finite Rees degeneration has an augmentation special-fibre functional. The known trivial-Gamma Hopf failure proves positive MZ cannot be inferred from that special fibre.
exact_controls: Explicit base invariance and quadratic equations,polar slice transitions,20/40-term full highest-form images,all8/12 derivative conditions,and nonzero norms8/15 and25/1092. Also256 residue controls,256 trivial-group quadratic-trace controls,and exact order6/20 leading terms proving old unary circuits fail the new first regularity test.
runtime: Python with Sympy1.14.0,exact rational/cyclotomic arithmetic;no support or moment-prefix campaign
logical_boundaries: Universal topology,torsor,Rees and trace arguments are written proofs,not machine-verified by the small checker.
The quadratic map is branched;the proof uses the regular birational torsor map and the cohomologically trivial deck action,not an invalid extension of the etale theorem.
The exact model is the constrained subalgebra S_K,not the entire quadratic ambient algebra. All markers must pass the derivative tests.
This resolves regularity and period transfer for the stated model but does not prove any exceptional MZ decision or exhaustion by an intrinsic safe class.
A pole-free rational-slice contour cannot represent the Haar cycle;the interval/constant-term expression is a transgression with boundary,not such a cycle.
A special-fibre augmentation ideal supplies no MZ ascent through the natural Rees degeneration.
